name: Claude
author: Brett
description: Claude settings (claude-settings@1): settings for Claude itself, kept on axHub (/projects/_shared/_data/claude/settings.json) so every Claude session (voice, chat, Claude Code, headless agents) reads the same values at its start and before acting (MCP claude_settings_get, CLI claude-settings.mjs). Groups: No wait (owner-only: Brett's own click turns on a standing all-scope veto pass so held calls run at once; Include irreversible, duration 1 h / 4 h / until off, auto-off at night; banner chip while on; off revokes the pass at once), Follow Amber (the same switch the follow-amber build reads), Builds (default model, launch without asking, max parallel, per-build and daily budget caps, named agent locked on, UI Review gate), Verification, Talking, Notifications, Memory and notes. Open registry: a new setting is data (registry.json, registry.d/, or the hub's claude/registry.json). Owner-only settings change only from Brett's signed-in console session; sessions and agents can change the rest. Page + Settings → Plugins → Claude; 'Claude settings' in every context menu.

keeps: /projects/_shared/_data/claude/settings.json on axHub: the settings every Claude session reads (shared by every project); delete it there by hand if the settings are no longer wanted
